reason: I do not buy from people I do not know, and a one-page writeup from a stranger in Roscoe about my business is not a referral, it is a cold pitch with homework attached. Nobody in my trade has vouched for this guy, so I would read it in the truck, shrug, and delete it.
objection: How do I know he understands HVAC/plumbing paperwork and how my jobs actually run? Anybody can write a page about where the time is going, I have had three of those this year. Show me an owner two towns over who will pick up the phone and tell me it worked.
would_change_my_mind: An owner I actually know in the trade, someone in my county, with my kind of crew size, telling me Donovin fixed their follow-up or their missed-call log and it stuck. A name and number I can call, not a testimonial page.
